::: {.oh-intro}
This booking page is for **API 209 students only**. Pick a **10-minute slot** below. The times you see come straight from my calendar, so anything open is genuinely open. After you book, you will receive a calendar invite with the Zoom link. Accept it and it lands on your calendar.
:::

```{=html}
<ul class="oh-meta">
  <li>10 minutes, one student per slot</li>
  <li>Bring your question, code, or problem set</li>
  <li>Over Zoom, link in the invite</li>
</ul>

<div class="oh-embed" id="oh-embed" hidden>
  <iframe id="oh-frame" title="Book an office hours slot" loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>

<div class="oh-setup" id="oh-setup" hidden>
  The booking calendar is not connected yet.<br>
  Paste the Google Calendar appointment link into <code>BOOKING_URL</code> in <code>office-hours/index.qmd</code>.
</div>

<p class="oh-fallback" id="oh-fallback" hidden>
  Calendar not loading? <a id="oh-link" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the booking page in a new tab</a>.
</p>

<script>
  // ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Google Calendar → Appointment schedule → Share → "Booking page" link.
  // Paste that link here. Nothing else on this page needs to change.
  const BOOKING_URL = "https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ2iK-ZkttOSsjk1kIOUaA2VbZPyQScB3Tl45_B6mzf7708VShD7iI-0HgoKR7CI7Nr0NagIrVhO";
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  (function () {
    const embed    = document.getElementById("oh-embed");
    const setup    = document.getElementById("oh-setup");
    const fallback = document.getElementById("oh-fallback");
    const frame    = document.getElementById("oh-frame");
    const link     = document.getElementById("oh-link");

    if (!BOOKING_URL) { setup.hidden = false; return; }

    // Google booking pages accept ?gv=true to render the embeddable view.
    const embedUrl = BOOKING_URL.includes("gv=true")
      ? BOOKING_URL
      : BOOKING_URL + (BOOKING_URL.includes("?") ? "&" : "?") + "gv=true";

    frame.src = embedUrl;
    link.href = BOOKING_URL;
    embed.hidden = false;
    fallback.hidden = false;
  })();
</script>

<div class="oh-notes">
  <div>
    <h3>Where</h3>
    <p>Office hours are on Zoom. The link is in the calendar invite you receive after booking.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Nothing open?</h3>
    <p>Email me at <a href="mailto:rrodriguezramirez@g.harvard.edu">rrodriguezramirez@g.harvard.edu</a> and we will find a time.</p>
  </div>
  <div>
    <h3>Groups</h3>
    <p>Working on the same problem with a classmate? Book one slot and come together.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
